subject: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro, open weights due by 4 Nov
text:
Source: https://www.kimi.ai/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro (source.mjs reads it; second outlet https://thenextweb.com/news/moonshot-kimi-k3-1-pro-open-weight-cyber)
Why it fits: a notable Models & Labs release. Moonshot pitches it as more reliable at financial modeling and research; open weights due by 4 Nov; API price $2 per million input tokens. (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
